title: Glessner's photographs re-read for the sign-off
items: Every Glessner photograph the model still differs from now says how. The Prairie front's small pair over the carriage way reads narrower in its north light in both the 1887 and 1965 prints, the stable gable's pigeon holes stand taller in both northwest views, and the 18th Street gable's pairs and light differ on HABS 13 and 14. Each finding is ticketed for the sign-off, and the register of what is attested against what is inferred now matches the current model.
